tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The thick cartoon outline on every drawn shape: aircraft, runways, buttons, panels, HUD chips. Never pure black. Also the colour of hard lip shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. The same in both themes: panels stay paper-light at night.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and hints on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed straight on bg-sky, sky-100 or sky-300, outside any panel: menu titles, version line.

tokens.name: on-sky-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text straight on bg-sky, sky-100 or sky-300.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any bright fill: sun, tangerine, cherry, success, sky-500, star and every path colour. Dark in both themes because the fills stay bright.

tokens.name: on-outline
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an outline-coloured fill: coach marks, tooltips, the callsign tag.

tokens.name: bg-sky
tokens.usage: Background of menus and every non-gameplay screen. The sky the UI lives in.

tokens.name: bg-field
tokens.usage: Background of the gameplay viewport: the airfield lawn.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, level cards and HUD chips. Paper-light in both themes so the outline always reads.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A surface sitting on a surface: toggle knobs, the selected segment, score popups.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and tracks: toggle track, segmented control trough, empty life slots, locked level art.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Quietest backdrop tint on bg-sky: far cloud bank, sunburst rays on menus. Text on it is on-sky.

tokens.name: sky-300
tokens.usage: Backdrop stripes and near cloud bank on bg-sky. Text on it is on-sky.

tokens.name: sky-500
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, info status, active toggle track. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: sky-700
tokens.usage: Links and emphasised text on surface and surface-raised; lip under sky-500 fills.

tokens.name: grass-300
tokens.usage: Light mowing stripe and grass tufts on the field.

tokens.name: grass-500
tokens.usage: Base lawn colour of the airfield.

tokens.name: grass-700
tokens.usage: Dark mowing stripe, taxiway verge, bushes.

tokens.name: grass-900
tokens.usage: Hedge and tree shade; grass detail next to asphalt.

tokens.name: asphalt-300
tokens.usage: Runway shoulder and apron wear.

tokens.name: asphalt-500
tokens.usage: Runway, taxiway and helipad surface.

tokens.name: asphalt-700
tokens.usage: Tyre marks and the touchdown zone on the runway.

tokens.name: marking
tokens.usage: Runway centre line, threshold bars, numbers and the helipad H, on asphalt-500 and asphalt-700.

tokens.name: marking-warn
tokens.usage: Helipad ring and hold-short lines, on asphalt-500 and asphalt-700.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, score, warning status. The game's signature yellow. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: sun-deep
tokens.usage: Lip and pressed shade under sun fills.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Streak badge, highlights, second aircraft livery. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: tangerine-deep
tokens.usage: Lip and pressed shade under tangerine fills.

tokens.name: cherry
tokens.usage: Lives, destructive buttons, collision alerts. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: cherry-deep
tokens.usage: Lip and pressed shade under cherry fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Safe landing, valid landing zone glow, confirmations. A teal, not a green, so it reads on the lawn and stays apart from cherry for colour-blind players. Always paired with a check icon or a word. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Collision, miss, wrong landing zone. Always paired with a warning icon or a word.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Near-miss warning ring between two aircraft.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral hints: next-aircraft arrow, tutorial pulses.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Inner band of the two-tone focus ring: 3px focus, then 3px outline outside it. One of the two bands always holds 3:1 against whatever the ring lands on.

tokens.name: path-1
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery of the 1st aircraft on screen. Path colours are assigned in order and reused once an aircraft lands.

tokens.name: path-2
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 2nd aircraft.

tokens.name: path-3
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 3rd aircraft.

tokens.name: path-4
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 4th aircraft. Bubblegum.

tokens.name: path-5
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 5th aircraft. Grape.

tokens.name: path-6
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 6th aircraft. Lagoon.

tokens.name: fuselage
tokens.usage: Aircraft body white.

tokens.name: fuselage-shade
tokens.usage: Engines, nacelles and the shaded side of the fuselage.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Cockpit windows. Keep them big.

tokens.name: glass-shine
tokens.usage: The single highlight streak on a cockpit window.

tokens.name: prop-blur
tokens.usage: Translucent disc of a spinning rotor.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Ambient drifting clouds above the field, drawn at opacity-cloud.

tokens.name: cloud-shade
tokens.usage: Underside of clouds.

tokens.name: shadow-ground
tokens.usage: The soft shadow an aircraft or cloud casts on the ground.

tokens.name: select-ring
tokens.usage: Dashed ring around the selected aircraft. Always drawn over an outline-coloured casing, like the flight path.

tokens.name: zone-ok
tokens.usage: Glow on a runway or helipad while the path end is a valid landing.

tokens.name: zone-no
tokens.usage: Glow on a landing zone of the wrong type for the selected aircraft.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Star burst on a safe landing; streak sparkles.

tokens.name: poof
tokens.usage: Comic poof cloud on a collision.

tokens.name: poof-shade
tokens.usage: Shaded lobes of the poof.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the field behind the pause and game-over dialogs.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The game title on the splash and main menu only.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Dialog headlines: Paused, Game over, Cleared to land.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Screen titles and the final score.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The live score in the HUD and score popups. Thin space as thousands separator.

styles.name: button-label-lg
styles.usage: Label of the large button: the main call to action on a menu.

styles.name: button-label-sm
styles.usage: Labels of small buttons, segments and chips.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Tap an aircraft, then drag to draw its path.
styles.usage: Tutorial copy and dialog lead text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Planes land on runways. Helicopters land on helipads.
styles.usage: All regular text. Never lighter than 500: thin strokes look weak beside the outlines.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Supporting text in cards and toasts.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Numbers that change while you watch: streak multiplier, countdowns, stats.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels above HUD values and settings groups. Write them in capitals.

styles.name: callsign
styles.usage: The tag that follows a selected aircraft. Uppercase letters and digits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; hearts in the lives meter.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and HUD pills; gap between segments.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between HUD items; small button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: HUD inset from the screen edge; card padding; default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between dialog buttons and copy.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between menu sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm on the main menu.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Title block offset on splash and game over.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, callsign tag, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, HUD chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and level cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, the streak badge, score popups, path dash caps.

tokens.name: shadow-lip-sm
tokens.usage: Hard lip under chips and small buttons. No blur: this is the toy-block edge.

tokens.name: shadow-lip
tokens.usage: Hard lip under buttons and HUD chips. Pressing a control collapses it to shadow-lip-sm and moves the control down by the difference.

tokens.name: shadow-lip-lg
tokens.usage: Hard lip under panels, cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Second, translucent lip that grounds a dialog on the scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The soft ground shadow of anything airborne: aircraft, clouds, score popups. Offset down-right, as if the sun sits top-left.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Inner top edge of sunken wells: toggle track, segmented trough.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Detail strokes inside a shape: window shine, runway dashes, grass tufts.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Outline of small UI: chips, toggles, icons at 24px.

tokens.name: line-3
tokens.usage: The default outline: aircraft, buttons, panels, runways.

tokens.name: line-4
tokens.usage: Outline of display type and of dialogs.

tokens.name: path-stroke
tokens.usage: Width of the coloured flight path dash.

tokens.name: path-casing
tokens.usage: Width of the outline-coloured casing drawn under the flight path.

tokens.name: path-dash
tokens.usage: Dash length of the flight path.

tokens.name: path-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between flight path dashes.

tokens.name: path-dot
tokens.usage: Diameter of the end dot of a flight path.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for any control.

tokens.name: touch-aircraft
tokens.usage: Minimum pick diameter around an aircraft, however small it is drawn.

tokens.name: hud-chip
tokens.usage: Height of HUD chips and icon buttons in the HUD.

tokens.name: button-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons (48px touch target with its margin).

tokens.name: button-md
tokens.usage: Height of default buttons.

tokens.name: button-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the main menu call to action.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips and small buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and HUD chips.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in coach marks and empty states.

tokens.name: sprite-light-prop
tokens.usage: Drawn size of the light prop at 1x viewport scale.

tokens.name: sprite-helicopter
tokens.usage: Drawn size of the helicopter, rotor disc included.

tokens.name: sprite-turboprop
tokens.usage: Drawn size of the turboprop.

tokens.name: sprite-jet
tokens.usage: Drawn size of the jet.

tokens.name: sprite-jumbo
tokens.usage: Drawn size of the jumbo. Exaggerated on purpose.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Button press and release.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Toggles, segment changes, selection ring appearing.

tokens.name: dur-pop
tokens.usage: Pop-in of chips, popups and coach marks.

tokens.name: dur-land
tokens.usage: Squash-and-stretch on touchdown before the aircraft disappears.

tokens.name: dur-burst
tokens.usage: Star burst and comic poof.

tokens.name: dur-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog drop-in.

tokens.name: dur-rotor
tokens.usage: One rotor or propeller revolution. Linear, endless.

tokens.name: dur-march
tokens.usage: One dash-length of flight path marching towards the end dot.

tokens.name: dur-sway
tokens.usage: One windsock wave.

tokens.name: dur-drift
tokens.usage: A cloud crossing the viewport.

tokens.name: ease-bounce
tokens.usage: Anything arriving: pop-ins, dialog drop, selection ring. Overshoots once.

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: State changes of controls: press, toggle, segment slide.

tokens.name: ease-out-soft
tokens.usage: Things leaving or fading: score popups rising, poof clearing.

tokens.name: ease-sway
tokens.usage: Ambient back-and-forth: windsock, idle bob.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and locked levels.

tokens.name: opacity-cloud
tokens.usage: Ambient clouds, so aircraft stay readable beneath them.

tokens.name: opacity-path-idle
tokens.usage: Paths of aircraft that are not selected.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: The straight-on projection drawn past a path end.

tokens.name: z-field
tokens.usage: Lawn, runways, helipads, ground decoration.

tokens.name: z-zone
tokens.usage: Landing zone glows.

tokens.name: z-path
tokens.usage: Flight paths and end dots.

tokens.name: z-ground-shadow
tokens.usage: Aircraft shadows, all below every aircraft.

tokens.name: z-aircraft
tokens.usage: Aircraft, selection ring, callsign tag.

tokens.name: z-fx
tokens.usage: Star bursts, poofs, score popups.

tokens.name: z-clouds
tokens.usage: Ambient clouds.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: HUD and coach marks.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim and dialogs.
